episode.title: This GIANT EAGLE Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a jungle set, a colossal eagle snatches a performer into its beak, then the crew pry its jaws open and he escapes unharmed.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators with their rigs in the foreground. One giant creature faces exactly one man, who stands his ground and watches its jaws begin to part.

A wide shot of Ihsan, dressed in earthy tones, standing on a rocky jungle outcrop within the dense set. Above him, a colossal, lifelike eagle head practical prop, dark brown feathers with smooth, overlapping texture, piercing golden eyes, and a formidable curved yellow beak, standing 3 metres tall, slowly begins to open its powerful beak. Misted jungle foliage frames the shot. Ambient sound only: distant bird calls, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The creature's jaws open wide and close over exactly one man until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with the man nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming.

A wide shot showing the colossal, lifelike eagle head practical prop, dark brown feathers with smooth, overlapping texture, piercing golden eyes, and a formidable curved yellow beak, standing 3 metres tall, its beak wide open, completely engulfing Ihsan. The beak then snaps shut with a resounding click. The eagle's feathers are sharply detailed under the studio lights. Ambient sound only: sharp click, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 3, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. Crew members put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and the same one man climbs out of the mouth onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal.

A wide shot of the colossal, lifelike eagle head practical prop, dark brown feathers with smooth, overlapping texture, piercing golden eyes, and a formidable curved yellow beak, standing 3 metres tall. Two crew members in black harnesses manually force open its powerful, hooked beak. Ihsan, completely unharmed, climbs out of the hollow, dark cavity of the prop onto the rocky jungle outcrop, adjusting his clothing. Ambient sound only: creaking mechanisms, studio air handling and distant crew movement.
